test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The compound interest (compounding annually) on a certain sum for 2 years at the rate of 20 percent per annum is Rs.2420. What will be the simple interest on the same sum for 3 years at the same rate of interest?
solution:
Given:

The compound interest for 2 years = Rs 2420

Time = 2 year

Rate = 20%

Formula used:

Compound interest = [Principal × [1 + r/100]ⁿ] - Principal

where n is time

Calculation:

Le the Principal be P.

Compound interest = [P × [1 + 20/100]²] - P

Compound interest = [P × [1 + 1/5]2] - P

Compound interest = [P × [6/5]2] - P

Compound interest = [P × 36/25] - P

⇒ 2420 = (36P - 25P)/25

⇒ 2420 = 11P/25

⇒ P = 220 × 25

⇒ P = 5500

Now the the simple interest on the same sum for 3 years at the same rate of interest will be:

Simple interest = (5500 × 20 × 3)/100

**Simple interest = 3300**
